The full test suite is green — **44 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors**, including the new Cp30 postcode-precedence tests and the existing Cp17/Cp29 locality/postcode tests.

## Summary

The locality derivation now prefers the postcode, falling back to the city table only when the postcode is absent or in no known range.

**`util/Locality.java`** — added an overload `of(String postcode, String city)` that:
- Looks up the region by postcode range first (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099).
- Falls back to the existing city-to-region table when the postcode is null/blank, malformed, or in no known range.
